title: End Only Elytra Flight
description:
A simple mod that restricts ALL (even modded) elytra flight to the end only.

Good for servers concerned about worldgen lag.

Has a config for disabling elytra flight entirely.
body:
A simple mod that prevents elytra use outside of the end in a **non-destructive** and **non-intrusive** way without any extra libraries. Supports Caelus.

You won't have to deal with your (and your player's) elytras dropping from the inventory or getting yote into the abyss cause they dared shift-click it out of habit.

Includes a config option to disable them entirely, in case you don't even want them used in the end.

May work on more minecraft versions due to how insanely simple this mod is, but I haven't checked.
